|errata_history={{Card errata/Ahch-To: Saddle (ALT)}}
This is the original release of [[Ahch-To: Saddle (ALT)]] (version 1 of 3). The image here is the Players Committee card image published 10 August 2021. The current text is [[Ahch-To: Saddle (ALT) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2). Each version below is quoted in full with its dated source. Every published image that differs visibly from the one before is a version (Bill, 12 November 2026); the <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of one date are one publication.
* '''Original''' (this page): Alternate-image card image published 10 August 2021<ref name="img-Original">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/25e5dad5826a9bb8e047c10fe325460bda7a7edc/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png holotable commit 25e5dad], 10 August 2021) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: May ▼ [Episode VII] Luke here. Once per turn, if Luke alone here, may subtract 2 from opponent's total power during a battle at another location.” Alternate-image card first published 10 August 2021 in the PC's alternate-image pack (holotable 25e5dad, “Virtual AI pack series 2”: PNG 1039×745 only; no GIF copy yet).
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ahch-To: Saddle (ALT) (Errata)]]): Alternate-image card image published 15 January 2022<ref name="img-PC-E1">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/793bf6567aab6b7f98de47650aedffa0d0097f93/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif holotable commit 793bf65], 15 January 2022); <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/17b52a9d067da2342f96b495fd63482ea55b8dcd/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png holotable commit 17b52a9], 15 January 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: May ▼ [Episode VII] Luke here. Once per turn, if Luke alone here, may subtract 2 from opponent's total power during a battle at another location.” '''Errata mark:''' this image prints no errata mark but is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026). '''What changed:''' The PC re-made the alternate image (holotable 17b52a9, “Alternate Image updates”, PNG 1039×745, and the first GIF copy 793bf65, 745×534, 15 January 2022): the art is re-cropped and re-coloured, the title bar and text box are smaller and sit higher, the Set 10 icon moved to the right of the text box, an [Episode VII] icon was added at the top of the right border, and the line down the right border “Artwork not affiliated or endorsed by Lucasfilm Ltd” became “ARTWORK NEITHER AFFILIATED WITH NOR ENDORSED BY LUCASFILM LTD.”. Words unchanged. On 11 June 2022 the PC re-made the GIF copy of this image at a larger size, 745×534 → 1039×745 pixels (holotable commit 6894629, “updated gif maker so that the landscape images are resized appropriately”<ref name="img-PC-E2">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/6894629d2267392808e0be34eb4aaa7686eced2c/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif holotable commit 6894629], 11 June 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>; [[:File:V10-L-ahchtosaddle_ai-2022-06-11.png]]); the new GIF is pixel-for-pixel this version's high-resolution PNG of 15 January 2022 (holotable 17b52a9), so it is a later copy of the same image in another format, not a new version (a version is one distinct image, dated when it was first published in any format; ALT-PNG, 13 Nov 2026). The PC's alternate-image catalogue of October 2022 prints this image<ref name="aicat-2022">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Official_Alternate_Images_2022.pdf Official Alternate Images], October 2022, p. 5 (this exact printed image edition).</ref>.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Ahch-To: Saddle (ALT) (Errata 2)]]): Alternate-image card image published 12 December 2022 (current; the image the PC card data uses)<ref name="img-PC-E3">Players Committee card image as published: <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/12d0bca60d8b85645ae7a6604003ce24123ce97c/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/large/ahchtosaddle_ai.gif holotable commit 12d0bca], 12 December 2022); <code>VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png</code> ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e9980f98a20d3e39594e801ec9cc0d58d1cab545/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualAlternateImage-Light/hires/ahchtosaddle_ai.png holotable commit e9980f9], 11 December 2022) (the PC's card-image repository, which serves res.starwarsccg.org/cards; <code>hires</code> PNG and <code>large</code> GIF copies of the same publication).</ref>: “Light: May ▼ [Episode VII] Luke here. Once per turn, if Luke alone here, may subtract 2 from opponent's total power during a battle at another location.” '''Errata mark:''' the image prints no errata mark; the words are the same as the previous version. '''What changed:''' The PC added the Players Committee logo beside “(AI)” at the lower left (holotable e9980f9, “Set 20 Errata, 2020 AIs, and a few fixes”, PNG, 11 December 2022; GIF 12d0bca, 12 December 2022). Words and art unchanged.
